relations.description: PDU session establishment procedure is guarded by maximum sessions reached condition
Maximum sessions reached condition is indicated by 5GMM cause #65
UE determines PLMN's maximum PDU sessions when cause #65 is received
UE determines SNPN's maximum PDU sessions when cause #65 is received
UE shall not send PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST when maximum sessions reached
UE must release an established PDU session before requesting new session when maximum reached
UE shall not release emergency PDU session when selecting which session to release
PDU session release procedure includes registration update to indicate session status to network
